title: Source
description: A retrieved source chunk with relevance score.

context.description: Neighbouring chunks of the same document, attached only when the request set context_window > 0 and at least one neighbour is visible; absent otherwise. Ordered by position (negative = before the source, positive = after). A neighbour that is itself a returned source is omitted here rather than duplicated.

position.description: Offset from the source in chunks: -1 is the immediately preceding chunk, 1 the following one.
